facts.fact: 甜夜次日：走廊挤满邻居与陌生人（有人激动、有人失神、身体晃动像被水流裹挟），楼下同样聚集——她恐慌：是我毁了两界平衡？
facts.anchor: bodies swaying slightly as if caught in a current

facts.fact: 对质：他从办公室那次就知情却隐瞒（不想给她负担）；「So you lied to me.」「I omitted——There's a difference.」「Not to me.」
facts.anchor: I omitted,” he responds, gentle in his deliverance.

facts.fact: 她的自责接管：「等我先死了就不会有这些事」；「And it's my fault. What isn't, at this point?」
facts.anchor: I should have waited until he was gone to jump.

facts.fact: 他反击：你来之前就在死——慢慢的、一天天褪色——「is that what you want to return to?」；她还击「你为得到想要的正在改动世界」；他爆发：「我要看你再笑、听你再笑、看你成为你本该成为的发光存在」——她喊「I never asked for any of that!」他平静：「You didn't ask for it, but it's what you are, nonetheless.」
facts.anchor: You were dying before I showed up

facts.fact: 逐出令：No more visits / no more flowers / For good.——他问「Is that truly what you want?」她心里尖叫 No，但援引神父规则（ch14：必须真心）逼自己 mean it：「That's what I want.」
他遵守条款：不进梦、不现身、留她过自己选的生活——「I will respect it and leave, Maven Talmay.」
facts.anchor: I will not visit your dreams. I will not appear in your waking hours.

facts.fact: 退路反转：「即使你改变主意、像我渴你一样渴我——我也不会回来。Though I will hear if you call for me.」（她后悔他也不回来，但他听得见召唤）
facts.anchor: Though I will hear if you call for me.

facts.fact: 群众散去、危机解除——「So why does it feel like I've made the worst mistake of my life?」她穿着他的衬衫卷在地板上喊「Go and don't come back!」——回答只有自己声音的碎回声。
facts.anchor: the shattered echo of my own voice
